sites.name: position-expression

replacements.name: offset-plus-parent
replacements.text:
Vector3 offset(Sin(phase) * radius, Cos(phase) * radius, 0.0f);
    sprite->position = offset + parent->transform.position;

replacements.name: parent-plus-offset
replacements.text:
Vector3 offset(Sin(phase) * radius, Cos(phase) * radius, 0.0f);
    sprite->position = parent->transform.position + offset;

replacements.name: inline-offset-plus-parent
replacements.text:
sprite->position = Vector3(Sin(phase) * radius, Cos(phase) * radius, 0.0f)
        + parent->transform.position;

replacements.name: inline-parent-plus-offset
replacements.text:
sprite->position = parent->transform.position
        + Vector3(Sin(phase) * radius, Cos(phase) * radius, 0.0f);
